==The Tomb of the Giggling Ghoul==

Region: the Singing Wastes

Connects to: 19.31.02.
==Overview==
This tomb lies empty for [[Ghoul in the Gilded Cage|its inhabitant]], one of the ghouls of the Singing Wastes, now sits madly giggling within a gilded cage in the heart of the city of Jahur.
==Hooks==
*What’s in the cave? Any interesting treasure?
